title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
hints: The formula is F = C × 9 / 5 + 32. `celsius` is a `double`, so the maths can keep decimals, as long as you don't accidentally do a whole-number division first.
Watch out: `9 / 5` on its own is two `int`s, so it's `1`, not `1.8`. Write `9.0 / 5.0` (or `1.8`), or multiply `celsius` first so the whole calculation stays a `double`.
